cards.h: How long before we see results?
p: Community growth and engagement typically show movement within 4-6 weeks. Revenue-attributable results depend on sales cycle length, but paid campaigns can show conversion signal within the first 30 days.

cards.h: Which platforms do you recommend for us?
p: It depends on your audience and goals. We run a platform audit as part of the Discover phase and recommend a focused mix rather than spreading thin across every channel.

cards.h: Do you produce the creative content yourselves?
p: Yes. Our in-house team handles copywriting, graphic design, video editing, and photography, along with sourcing when specialised production is required.

cards.h: Can you work alongside our existing marketing team?
p: Yes. We integrate with in-house teams and other agencies, operating as your social media specialists within a broader marketing function.
